STI.P: SPECIAL PROVISIONS REFERRED TO IN ARTICLE 1 OF THE PROTOCOL

CONTENTS.P: In addition to the existing permanent duty free tariff quotas, the European Union shall open the following annual duty free tariff quotas for products originating in Iceland:

NOTE.P: Quantities shall be added in accordance with Article 2 paragraph 3 of this Protocol.
The benefit of the tariff quota shall not be granted to goods declared for release for free circulation during the period 15 February to 15 June.
